Introduction

Max Changmin also known as Choikang Changmin is a South Korean singer, actor, and lyricist under SM Entertainment. He is a member of the male duo TVXQ! and the project ballad group S.M. THE BALLAD.

He released his first Japanese solo debut mini album, "Close To You", on November 18, 2015 and made his Korean solo debut on April 6, 2020 with the mini album "Chocolate".
